handle_non_streaming_A2A_completion: handle non-streaming A2A requests by routing them through litellm.acompletion and returning an A2A SendMessageResponse
handle_streaming_A2A_completion: handle streaming A2A requests by yielding A2A task, status-update, and artifact-update events via litellm.acompletion
handle_a2a_completion: handle non-streaming A2A completion requests through the convenience function that delegates to A2ACompletionBridgeHandler
handle_a2a_completion_streaming: handle streaming A2A completion requests through the convenience function that delegates to A2ACompletionBridgeHandler
route_A2A_requests_with_provider_config: route A2A requests through provider-specific configs or fall back to generic litellm.acompletion with custom_llm_provider
